column2: (4) Any person who offers, solicits or accepts a gratification
which  is  an  offence  under  this  Act  shall,  if  such  offer,
solicitation  or  acceptance  was  made  outside  Sri  Lanka,  be
deemed to have committed such offence within Sri Lanka,
and  accordingly  the  High  Court  holden  in  Colombo  shall
have jurisdiction to try such offence notwithstanding anything
to the contrary in any other written law.
